blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda has filed Senate Bill No. 2521, or the proposed Fisheries Vessel Monitoring Act, to strengthen the monitoring of fishing vessels, combat illegal fishing and protect the livelihoods of small-scale fishers. The measure seeks to establish an electronic vessel monitoring framework to combat illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing within the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone (EEZ) and along its 36,289-kilometer coastline. “Our oceans are extremely important, as they are rich in resources that sustain our country. They also provide a livelihood for our small-scale fishers and coastal communities. We will not allow those who exploit our […]...
